summary: Compose bounded native agent SQL capture, primary-key extraction, canonical input and private delivery-source storage for the agent collection integration.

replay.detail: Explicit opt-in installation pages complete receiver-bound source tables at up to 128 rows/1 MiB per snapshot. Namespace repairs and captured clocks share a bounded maintenance budget; native-agent-collection-source.json describes actual native startup/recovery projection and fresh namespace publication.

schema.detail: Explicit installation persists exact recursive-source descriptors and creates private delivery, namespace physical/canonical shadow, producer-boundary and singleton captured-clock tables. Normal Store opens remain unchanged; no numeric database version change.

rules.detail: Public card admission and mutable-verdict policy are unchanged. The explicit capture fingerprint binds the default st3 registry/projection digest and current unfiltered-verdict domain.

compatibility.detail: Paired collection sockets now revalidate at the grant expiration deadline and close with a forbidden error on refusal, instead of waiting for a per-subscription error on a later approximately 30-second tick. The slot wait and physical validation run outside the socket loop so pings and commands remain live. Local read-only Unix sessions keep their legacy read authority without requiring a person header or pairing grant. Local-observation pruning and checkpoint state writes use managed transactions on default Stores too; batch commit errors preserve the full cause chain. Delivery presence updates acquire the source mutex even without an installed source owner. Existing v0 frames and generated clients remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: The default Store has no IVM source installer or backfill. Opt-in startup and populated installation costs require separate measurements; source preparation failure refuses agents while other collection readers remain available.

manual.detail: No deployment action activates these local integration helpers. Explicit source installation requires managed hooks, complete family/authority/deadline proof, a retained producer registration and one shared Store Publisher.

recovery.detail: Raw capture gaps, descriptor changes and unsupported source closure remain fenced. Temporary producer acknowledgement/dirty output gaps use bounded collection retries. Restore or changed source epoch needs a separately qualified namespace-binding lifecycle.
